scope: Existing ground/contact loss and geometry review for Stage-conditioned model-level constraints. No tracking rerun or world accuracy evaluation.

original_mainline.decision: Mainline had optional contact implementation but did not activate contact losses.

surface_geometry.decision: Never project heel anchors to z=0. First solve a contact-feasible pose then freeze actual heel and all sole candidate positions. A heel-only anchor allows forefoot rotation.

original_surface_parameters.reliability_normalization: sum labels*surface loss/(2N), then objective lambda
original_surface_parameters.nonpenetration_helper: relu(margin-z)^2; margin +3mm is positive clearance, not tolerated -3mm penetration

candidate_contact_gate.constructed_extra_gate: baseline min sole >= -3mm; current/previous finite accepted frame; only sticking candidate enables tangential loss
candidate_contact_gate.decision: Same-source engineered candidate, not physical contact. Do not use it to shrink the full requested Stage2 interval.

stage2.gaps: Keep existing episode anchors through transitions; unlock on Stage1 confirmation; do not repeatedly re-anchor fragmented Stage2 portions.

new_tool.constraint: all selected sole minima >= -5mm; Stage2 both minima <= +5mm; each heel and each of the 54 sole candidates within 10mm of fixed episode anchor
new_tool.test_result: 12 targeted tests passed; Ruff E9/F passed. Geometry, inequality and batching only; no solver success claim.

limits: All coordinates here are conditioned on the existing Stage/ground support protocol, which reuses ankle observations and includes 0.5s fixed-lag future evidence.
Sole sets are actual naked SMPL-H surface candidates, not measured shoe soles.
Hard pose constraints need joint q/v/a correction and explicit infeasibility recording in the tracker; these geometry tools do not solve or suppress conflicts.
The original balanced-grasp median/representative-frame anchors use whole segments and cannot be copied as causal anchors.
